name: Metadata Refresh Reliability & Monitoring Integrity
changes: Correct scheduled metadata refresh loop to process every monitored movie and TV title rather than only the first item.
Immediately perform a full sweep once after upgrading from the broken v3.7.28 scheduler, without changing existing user settings.
Require a live Metadata Service response for verified refreshes; never stamp a 30-day local cached fallback as fresh.
Track per-title failures and retry at most 20 failed titles every 15 minutes until verified or the next full sweep.
Never partially overwrite imported movie/TV file state when a title metadata merge fails.
Notify automatic Wanted scheduler when fresh home dates or TV episodes cause monitored content to become eligible.
Display per-title metadata last-success/error in the detail pane and verified/attempted/pending counts in Automation Health.
Fix v3.7.27 Windows CI failure by removing the obsolete v3.7.26 version-specific gate and replacing it with a v3.7.28 gate; retain all v3.7.26 targeted functional tests.
Nonblocking in-memory SAB Queue progress pulse with explicit stale indicators and a maximum of 500 items; no extra SAB API reads.
Downloads visible view uses bounded lightweight progress between full authoritative snapshots, avoiding full queue/history rebuild at every 500 ms tick.
Existing rows and one-job Image Set package progress update in place, keeping queue controls and completion state on authoritative snapshots.
A lightweight Diagnostics heartbeat responds separately from heavy download/automation/storage aggregation.
Bulk Image Set queue submission yields to the browser after every three batches and tracks in-progress submission without changing submitted job identities or retry decisions.
UI event-loop stalls, full-refresh age, pulse failures and queue-submission activity appear in copied Diagnostics to help reproduce load-related pauses.
Quiet full-snapshot failure backoff and visibly stale status avoid repeated expensive retries and falsely presenting stale progress as fresh.
regression_guards: Real production-AST test with 57 TV and 6 movie titles: complete full sweep, targeted manual refresh, failed and recovered metadata.
Fresh-fetch bypasses long-lived local response fallbacks; incomplete TV season lists fail safe without deleting existing episode records.
v3.7.29-only full release gate; do not execute older version-specific full gates (prior v3.7.27 CI failure).
No search-index/history addition, SAB queue modification, or alteration to metadata server/diagnostics collector.

Version-specific full release gates may only run for their own version; v3.7.28 verifies existing v3.7.27 Downloads/Diagnostics and v3.7.26 search features without invoking older version identity tests.
Real SAB presentation_pulse AST tests: no control reads/state writes, bounded rows, fresh/stale semantics and realistic slot conversion.
UI simulation tests: no stale progress application, progress never rewinds, package/row progress updates without rebuilding the DOM.
No change to SAB queue mutations or completion/history deletion; existing guarded add and control logic is preserved.
All previous v3.7.26 NNTP search, v3.7.25 Image Sets layout, v3.7.24 yEnc inspection, v3.7.22 filename and v3.7.19 disk caching guards remain enabled.
preserved: No persistent search index, new search history, download migration, deletion or new database.
Original SABnzbd 5.1.2, SABCTools 9.6.3, provider allocations, service/tray, user settings and persisted download history.
Metadata Server 0.3.3 and Diagnostic Collector 1.0.31 unchanged.
